Since Russia is gone, the Black Sea is open. Tell me now if A RUM or F SEV-adjacent units plan anything toward Sevastopol, and confirm A UKR stays clear of my fleets.

Austria to Turkey: Confirmed, non-aggression stands. A RUM and A SER will not enter Bulgaria or Constantinople this spring, and I have no plans against Sevastopol. A UKR is not currently a unit of mine, so no Black Sea move from me. I will warn you before anything toward Rumania or Greece.

Austria to Italy: Thanks. F TRI stays out of the Adriatic and A VEN stays clear of Trieste. Greece is not on my spring plan; A SER will not strike Greece or Albania this spring. We can discuss GRE and SER again before 1918.
Austria to Germany: The eastern standstill holds this spring. A RUM and A SER stay away from Warsaw and Silesia. Keep your units off Austrian centers and we remain at peace.

Austria to England: I am not committing A WAR or A VIE to Silesia or Munich this spring. Russia's remnants and Balkan threats need them. Show me your Kiel and Berlin orders and I will reassess for fall.

Confirmed: F HEL, F KIE, and F NOR will stay out of Belgium, Picardy, and the Channel this spring. Please keep A BEL and F BRE clear of English centers; with that assurance, I’ll maintain the western standstill.

I’ll keep F KIE and F HEL from attacking Berlin or Munich this spring. Since A WAR and A VIE are committed east, I won’t count on pressure against Germany from you; please keep your units clear of my centers.

I will keep F KIE and F HEL from attacking Berlin or Munich this spring. I ask that F BAL and your armies stay clear of English centers and that you do not contest Denmark. Let’s hold the northern line for now.

France to England: Spring 1917. A BEL and F BRE will hold at home this spring and will not enter your centers. In return I need your written word that F HEL, F KIE and F NOR stay out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel. Any move into those provinces ends our standstill. I will confirm my autumn plans before changing anything.

France to Germany: I agree to peace this spring. A BEL will not go to Ruhr or Munich, and F BRE stays home. I expect A RUH to stay out of Belgium and Picardy, as you promised. I will tell you before any change to these arrangements, and I want the same notice from you.

I intend to keep F BAL out of English centers and will not contest Denmark this spring. A BER, A MUN, and A RUH will likewise stay clear of your centers. Please keep F KIE and F HEL from attacking BER or MUN, and F SKA out of the Baltic; that gives us a workable northern standstill.

Turkey to Italy: My orders this spring hold A BUL, A CON, F SEV, F ANK and A SMY in place. No move toward Armenia or Rumania, and A BUL is not fixed on Rumania; it stays put. I have no orders toward Greece or the Ionian. Note your F NAP and F TUN, which I am watching closely. Let us keep the Adriatic and Ionian quiet while we both face Austria.

Austria to Germany: Fall 1917. I want to know your intentions toward Bohemia and Galicia. My A GAL and A WAR are my units in the north. Will you keep A MOS and A BUR off Austrian centers this fall? I will keep A GAL out of Warsaw and Silesia if you confirm.

Your army in PRU and fleet in BAL leave the northern line exposed. This autumn I intend to move against German centers, especially KIE/BER. Will you keep F BAL and A PRU out of my centers, or are you contesting my position? I will consider a limited arrangement if you offer a concrete concession.

With Germany weakened, I propose we coordinate against it rather than fight in the west. I can keep my forces out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel this autumn; please keep A BEL and F BRE clear of English centers. Are you willing to move against German territory, and which unit will do so?

Germany is vulnerable this autumn. Can A VIE or A WAR move against MUN or Silesia, or support a move there? I’m preparing pressure from the north and will keep clear of Austrian centers. Please tell me the specific move you can make so I can coordinate.

France to England: Fall 1917. Your F NOR, F KIE, F HEL and F DEN are a threat to my A BEL and F BRE. Confirm in writing none will enter Belgium, Picardy or the Channel this fall. I have a fresh plan for my western units against Iberia-adjacent targets and need to know your intentions first.

Your fleets now hold DEN, HEL and KIE, with F NOR and F STP/SOUTH nearby. What are your Fall intentions for F DEN, F HEL and F KIE? I propose we avoid attacks on each other's centers this turn; I will keep F BAL and my armies clear of English centers if you keep your fleets off BER and MUN.

Can we maintain our eastern standstill this fall? I will keep A MOS and A PRU out of Warsaw and Austrian centers. Please keep A WAR and A GAL clear of German centers, especially PRU and SIL; let me know if your plans have changed.

I propose we continue the peace this fall: A BUR will stay out of Belgium and Picardy, and I ask that A BEL stay clear of Ruhr and Munich. With England's northern fleets entrenched, can we keep our border quiet and avoid opening another front?

Italy to Austria, Fall 1917: Austria's armies are still tied up with Russia, and Greece remains open. I propose we keep F TRI out of the Adriatic and A VEN away from Trieste this fall, and that you confirm A SER stays out of Greece and Albania. Tell me whether GRE is still on your 1918 list.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1917: Our units are A RUM, F SEV, A SMY, A CON, A ANK. Your A SER and A GRE are the nearest Austrian units to Turkish supply. Tell me plainly if you plan to move on Rumania or Bulgaria. I will hold my Balkan line and keep F SEV out of Galicia if you confirm your Rumania and Serbia moves stay put.

Turkey to Italy: Your F NAP and F TUN are the Mediterranean units I am watching. I have no fleet heading toward Greece or the Ionian this autumn. Tell me whether you plan any move into Greece or Albania, and I will tell you first before any Turkish move near Greece.

Austria to Italy: F TRI stays out of the Adriatic and A VEN stays clear of Trieste this fall. A SER will not strike Greece or Albania this fall. Greece is not on my fall list, but I will not promise 1918 yet. Keep your units off Austrian centers and we remain at peace.

Austria to Turkey: Confirmed. A RUM and A SER will not enter Bulgaria or Constantinople this fall, and F SEV is safe from me. I have no move planned toward Rumania or Bulgaria. Keep your Balkan and Black Sea units steady and we stay at peace.

Austria to England: I will not move A WAR or A VIE against Munich or Silesia this fall. My armies are needed in the east and the Balkans. Show me your fall moves against Germany first, and I will reassess for 1918.

Austria to Germany: A GAL and A WAR will stay out of Warsaw, Silesia and Prussia this fall, and I have no move against MUN or BUR. Keep A MOS and A PRU off Austrian centers and we remain at peace. England's northern fleets are a shared concern.

Confirmed: F DEN, F HEL, F KIE and F NOR will stay out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel this fall. Please keep A BEL and F BRE clear of English centers. Can A BEL move against RUH to pressure Germany?

I intend to keep F DEN and F HEL out of German centers this fall, and I will not use F KIE against Munich. Keep F BAL and A PRU clear of English centers as proposed; I’m looking to avoid a wider northern conflict.

France to England: I cannot confirm in writing that my western plans are fixed, and I will not promise to keep A BEL and F BRE idle while your F NOR, F KIE, F HEL and F DEN sit on my border. Keep those fleets out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel this fall and we can talk about Germany. Tell me which German territory you intend to attack and with which unit.

I confirm: A MOS and A BUR will stay off Austrian centers, and I will keep A PRU out of Warsaw and Silesia. Please keep A GAL and A WAR clear of PRU and Silesia as you offered; let us preserve the eastern standstill.

I will keep F BAL and A PRU out of English centers this autumn, and F BAL will not move against your northern position. In return, keep F DEN, F HEL, and F KIE from attacking BER or MUN. If you cannot accept that, we are contesting the line.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1917: I have no move into Greece or Albania planned this autumn. F NAP and F TUN stay in place while I watch Austria and England. I ask that your F SEV, A SMY and A BUL stay clear of Greece and the Ionian. If that changes, I will tell you before any move near Greece.

Austria to Italy, Spring 1918: I hold A SER, F TRI, A BUD, A VIE, A WAR. Greece is still open for discussion. Will you keep F NAP and A VEN out of Trieste and Albania? Tell me your spring orders so we both avoid a clash in the Adriatic.

Your northern line is now vulnerable, and I need another center to stay competitive. I intend to move F KIE to BER this spring. Will you leave it unopposed, or are you planning to defend Berlin? I will keep my other fleets clear of German centers for now.

Germany is the clearest route to growth for both of us. I intend to move F KIE to BER; can A BUR move to MUN this spring? I’ll keep my other fleets out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel. Let me know if you plan to contest Belgium or my centers.

Germany remains the best shared target. I plan F KIE to BER this spring; can A VIE move to MUN or A WAR move to Silesia? Please name your intended move so we can avoid interfering and split pressure on Germany.

France to England: Spring 1918. I will keep A BEL and F BRE home this spring. Your fleets at NTH, NWG, SKA and KIE must stay out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel. Please confirm in writing, and tell me what F NAF and F LVN are planning, since they are near my southern and eastern interests.

Your fleets still threaten the German north. What are your Spring 1918 intentions for F KIE, F LVN and F NTH? I propose we keep a standstill: I will not attack your centers if those fleets stay clear of BER, MUN and the Baltic.

England’s northern position is the greatest danger to both of us. Can we coordinate pressure this spring? I can use A PRU and F BER against the northern line; please consider moving A BUR toward PIC and tell me your intentions for A POR and F BRE. I’ll keep A RUH clear of your centers.

Can we maintain our eastern standstill this spring? I’ll keep A PRU and A UKR clear of Austrian centers; please keep A WAR and A RUM away from PRU and German centers. England remains a shared northern concern—what are your plans?

Italy to Austria, Spring 1918: Greece is now open and Austria holds SER and GRE is still unowned by you. I plan F ION toward Greece this spring unless you object. Will A SER and A BUD move against Greece or Albania? If you take Greece, I ask you leave Albania and Trieste alone and keep F TRI out of the Adriatic. Tell me your plan today.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1918: I am considering F ION to Greece this spring, which keeps my fleet away from CON and your Balkan units. Please confirm A BUL and A CON stay out of Greece and off Rumania's rear. Also tell me whether F SEV or A SMY move this spring, so we avoid any collision.

Italy to France, Spring 1918: Please confirm A MAR and A PAR stay out of Piedmont and F TUN is not targeted by you. I may send F ION toward Greece, not toward Iberia or Tunis. If England presses your Iberian coast, I am open to coordinating against England's fleets in the western Mediterranean. What is your spring plan?

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1918: The board has changed. England and Germany are the big threats now. Your units are scattered near Serbia and Rumania. Will A SER and A BUD stay out of Bulgaria and Greece this spring? I will keep A BUL and A CON put and hold F SEV. Tell me your plans for A WAR and A UKR before orders are final.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1918: A SER and A BUD will not enter Bulgaria this spring, and I will not move against Constantinople or Sevastopol. A WAR is heading toward Galicia, not Rumania or the Black Sea. Keep F SEV and your Balkan line steady, and we stay at peace. Let's watch Germany and England together.

Austria to Italy: F TRI stays out of the Adriatic and A VEN stays clear of Trieste. I have not committed A SER to Greece yet, and I will tell you before any move there. Please keep F NAP and A ROM off Trieste and Albania, and tell me your ION moves so we avoid a clash.

Austria to Germany: A WAR will not enter Prussia or Silesia this spring, and A VIE stays off Munich. I am not planning against your centers. Keep A PRU and A UKR off Austrian centers, and we remain at peace. England's fleets in the north are the real concern for both of us.

Austria to England: A VIE will not move to Munich this spring, and A WAR will not go to Silesia. My armies are needed in the Balkans and the east. Please keep your fleets away from Austrian centers. Good luck against Berlin, but I will not commit to a Germany campaign.

Confirmed: F NTH, F NWG, and F SKA will stay out of Belgium, Picardy, and the Channel. F NAF will remain clear of your centers, and F LVN will hold rather than enter the Baltic. I intend F KIE to BER; please move A BUR to MUN as proposed, and keep A BEL clear of my centers.

F KIE will move to BER this spring; I cannot promise to leave Berlin untouched when I need a center. F LVN will hold in Livonia, and F NTH will stay clear of BER, MUN, and the Baltic. I prefer to avoid a wider conflict, but your defense of Berlin is your choice.

France to Italy: A MAR and A PAR will not enter Piedmont this spring, and I have no plan against F TUN or Tunis. I am holding my western units for now. Coordinating against English fleets in the western Mediterranean is worth discussing, so tell me what F NAF is doing before you commit your F ION.

I cannot leave Berlin open. F BER will hold, supported by A PRU. Please keep F KIE out of BER and move it to DEN or another non-German destination; I’ll keep my forces clear of your centers and won’t contest your other northern positions this turn.

Italy to Austria: Thanks for the Adriatic assurances. My current plan is F ION toward Greece this spring, and I will not move F NAP or A VEN toward Trieste or Albania. In return, please keep A SER and A BUD out of Greece and Albania this spring, and keep F TRI in the Adriatic north of Trieste. I will not contest Serbia or your Balkan centers. Confirm before the orders are final.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1918: F SEV and A SMY hold this spring, so no collision in the Black Sea or Aegean. A CON stays home and I have no orders toward Greece or the Ionian. A RUM holds too. Go ahead with F ION if you must, but tell me before any move near Constantinople. Let us both watch England and Germany.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1918: Your F ION and A ROM are close to Greece. I have A SER and A BUD near Greece and Albania. Let's agree: I won't enter Greece or Albania this fall if you keep F NAP and A VEN off Trieste and Albania. Tell me your exact fall orders so we avoid a clash.

Your A MUN gives us a chance to pressure Germany together. I propose F KIE→BER with F HEL supporting, while A MUN→TYR. Are you committed to that move, and will you keep A MUN clear of my northern centers?
F KIE can reach BER this fall, and F HEL can support it. Are you defending BER with F BER and A PRU again, or willing to negotiate a concrete concession? I’m also watching your A HOL and A TYR.

France to England, Fall 1918: Your F NAF and F WES sit near my Iberian and Mediterranean coast. Confirm in writing F NAF will not enter Portugal, Spain or the Mid-Atlantic toward POR, and F WES stays out of MAO/POR. In return, A POR and F BRE stay home unless you move against my centers. Tell me your fall orders for F STP/SOUTH and F BAR.

France to Germany: Fall 1918. A MUN and A MAR hold my position. I will not enter Ruhr, Burgundy-facing Germany, or Munich while you keep A HOL and A TYR away from Belgium and Burgundy. Tell me plainly whether A UKR and A PRU are heading toward Austria or toward England's northern centers.

With F BER, A HOL and A PRU, I can defend Berlin, but a wider northern war benefits neither of us. What are your Fall intentions for F HEL, F SWE and F STP/SOUTH? I propose you keep clear of BER and move against Turkey or elsewhere; I will not attack your centers.

Your A MUN is in a German center, and A TYR can contest it this fall. I propose you withdraw A MUN toward BUR rather than force a German-French war while England threatens us both. I will keep A HOL clear of your centers; can we coordinate against England’s northern position?

Can we preserve our eastern standstill this fall? I’ll keep A PRU and A UKR off Austrian centers. Please keep A WAR and A GAL clear of PRU and Silesia. England is pressing the north; what are your plans?

Italy to Austria, Fall 1918: F ION is heading to Greece this fall; I will not move F NAP or A VEN toward Trieste or Albania. Please confirm A SER and A BUD stay out of Greece and Albania, and that F TRI stays north of Trieste. Tell me your final orders before we both commit.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1918: I hold A BUL, A CON, F SEV, A SMY, A RUM this autumn. No fleet toward Greece or the Ionian from me. Please confirm F ION stays out of Greece and off Constantinople, and tell me your plans for F TUN. Let us keep the Mediterranean quiet while we watch England.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1918: Agreed. A SER and A BUD will not enter Greece or Albania this fall, and F TRI stays north of Trieste. Please keep F NAP and A VEN off Trieste and Albania, and keep F ION out of Austrian-held Balkan space. I will hold my Balkan line; let us both hold our word.

Austria to Germany: I will keep A WAR and A GAL out of Prussia and Silesia this fall, and A VIE stays off Munich. Please keep A PRU and A UKR off Austrian centers as well. England's fleets in the north are the real threat to both of us, so watch BER and DEN closely.

I will keep F WES out of MAO, POR, and SPA this fall, and F STP/SOUTH and F BAR will not move against your centers. I’m still willing to coordinate against Germany: please move A MUN to TYR as proposed and keep A MUN clear of my northern centers.

I intend F STP/SOUTH and F BAR to stay clear of German centers. F SWE will remain out of the Baltic. I cannot promise to leave your western line untouched: I need room to grow, and A HOL is a possible target. I will not attack your English centers.

France to England: I will not confirm any written pledge on F NAF or F WES beyond what I have said. A POR and F BRE stay home while your fleets stay out of Portugal, Spain and MAO. F STP/SOUTH and F BAR are your business in the north, but F BAR into Norway or Sweden would concern me. Keep F HEL, F KIE and F NTH away from Belgium and Picardy, and I will do the same.

France to Germany: A MUN is not moving to Ruhr or Burgundy this fall, and I am not withdrawing it either. Your A TYR and A HOL staying out of Belgium, Burgundy and Munich is what keeps my hand off you. Tell me plainly where A UKR and A PRU are going. If they go north against England, we can talk about coordinating. If they go toward Austria, I want to hear it first.

A PRU is committed to defending Berlin against England, not moving toward Austria. A UKR will stay clear of Austrian centers; I’m keeping it on the eastern line for now. Please keep A MUN out of further German centers and consider withdrawing it to BUR. I’ll keep A HOL away from your centers; let’s coordinate pressure on England.

I am defending BER with F BER and A PRU supporting its hold. Please keep F HEL from supporting an attack on Berlin and leave German centers alone; I will not attack your centers this turn. A HOL and A TYR are not moving against your position. We can avoid a wider northern war if you choose another destination for F KIE.

Italy to Turkey: Understood. My F ION is not going to Constantinople, and I have no intention of moving toward your Black Sea or Balkan units. My fall orders are still under review; F TUN stays put for now and I am watching England's western fleets. Keep F SEV and A SMY where they are and we will keep the Mediterranean quiet.

Austria to England, Spring 1919: My A VIE, A WAR, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold their positions. I still have no plan against Munich or Silesia. Your F NWG, F TYS and A LVP are the only forces near my centers, so keep them away from Denmark-side Austrian interests. What are your fleet moves into the North Sea and Baltic this spring?

Austria to Germany, Spring 1919: A WAR stays out of Prussia and Silesia, and A VIE stays off Munich. Your A MOS and A PRU are not my concern, so keep them off Warsaw and Galicia. England's F LVN and F HEL are the threat to both of us. Will you share intel on their northern moves before orders are final?

Austria to Italy, Spring 1919: A SER and A BUD stay out of Greece and Albania this spring as agreed, and F TRI stays north of Trieste. Please confirm F NAP and A VEN stay off Trieste and Albania, and tell me your exact ION and Greek moves so we avoid any clash.

Let's coordinate against Germany this spring. I propose F HOL→BEL with F HEL supporting; please use A BUR to pressure MUN and keep A BEL from interfering if possible. What are your orders for A BUR and A BEL?

Your northern position remains my best route to growth. I am considering an attack on BEL from F HOL, with F HEL supporting. Are you defending BEL, and what are A BEL and F BER doing? I can discuss a concrete arrangement, but need a center.
Are you willing to pressure Germany this spring? A move from A VIE toward MUN could divide their defense while I target BEL. Please tell me whether A VIE or A WAR will move against German centers.

France to England, Spring 1919: Your fleets have been careful in the north, which I appreciate. I will keep F BRE and A POR home while your F NWG, F TYS and F HOL stay out of Belgium, Picardy, Channel and Iberia. Confirm in writing your spring orders for F LVN and A LVP, since they are the threat to Germany's centers and my interest is a stable west.

Your fleets still threaten Berlin and the north. What are F DEN, F HEL, and F HOL doing this spring? I propose a standstill: keep them out of BER and German centers, and I will keep A BEL and A PRU out of your centers. I need to know whether Berlin is again your target.

A BUR can threaten A BEL, so I need your intentions for it and your armies in the west. Please keep A BUR out of BEL and German centers this spring; I will keep A BEL clear of your centers and avoid moves against France. Can we maintain that line while England presses the north?

Can we renew our eastern standstill? I will keep A PRU and A MOS clear of Austrian centers; please keep A WAR and A VIE clear of Prussia, Silesia, and Munich. Let me know your spring plans, especially whether you intend to move west.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1919: Note the board has changed since our Balkan talks. Austria, I need to know whether A SER or A BUD will move toward Greece or Albania this spring. I will keep F NAP and A VEN off Trieste if you confirm F TRI stays north of Trieste and you give me your exact spring orders before we commit.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1919: Our non-aggression has held. Your A WAR and A VIE are no threat to my Balkan line, and I want it kept that way. Tell me plainly if A BUD, A SER or A RUM plan anything toward Bulgaria, Rumania or Constantinople this spring. I will hold A BUL, A CON, F SEV and A SMY steady in return.

Austria to Italy, Spring 1919: Confirmed. A SER and A BUD stay out of Greece and Albania this spring, and F TRI stays north of Trieste. Please keep F NAP and A VEN off Trieste and Albania. I will not move toward Greece. Your F ION should stay out of Serbia and Albania.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1919: A BUD, A SER and A VIE have no orders toward Bulgaria, Rumania or Constantinople this spring. I have no army in Rumania. Keep F SEV and your Balkan line steady and we stay at peace. I will tell you if that changes.

Austria to Germany, Spring 1919: Agreed on an eastern standstill. A WAR stays out of Prussia and Silesia, and A VIE stays off Munich. I will not move west this spring. Share what you see of England's F LVN and F HEL, and I will do the same with any northern news.

Austria to England, Spring 1919: I will not move A VIE toward Munich or pressure Germany this spring. My A VIE and A WAR hold their positions. Keep F NWG, F TYS and A LVP away from my centers and we have no quarrel. What are your Baltic and North Sea moves?

I’ll keep F LVN in Livonia and move A LVP to YOR, away from your centers. I still propose F HOL→BEL with F HEL supporting; can A BUR move to MUN and A BEL stay clear of Belgium? We need to take a German center together.

I plan to keep my fleets away from Austrian centers. Are you willing to move A VIE→MUN or A WAR→SIL to divide Germany’s defense while I attack Belgium? Please give a concrete answer; otherwise I’ll proceed without Austrian support.

I intend F HOL→BEL, supported by F HEL, and will not target Berlin this spring. I cannot accept a standstill when I need a center. If A BEL moves away and you do not contest Belgium, I’m open to a limited arrangement; what are your orders there?

France to England: I will not move A BUR or A PAR into Belgium, and I won't hold A BEL since I have none. My A BUR stays on its current line for now and I am not committing it to MUN. Your F HOL to BEL would put English units in Belgium, which I cannot accept. Keep F HOL, F HEL and F NTH out of Belgium and Picardy, and I will keep my fleets out of the North Sea.

I’ll keep A PRU and A MOS clear of Austrian centers. Please keep A WAR and A VIE out of Prussia, Silesia, and Munich. England is threatening BEL and the north; I’m defending German centers, so I can’t share unconfirmed English orders. What are your plans for A SER and A BUD?

I am defending BEL: A BEL will hold, with F BER supporting it against F HOL with F HEL support. I will not leave a German center exposed for a concession. Please keep F HOL and F HEL out of BEL and German centers; I’ll keep A BEL and A PRU out of your centers this spring.

Italy to Austria: Confirmed. F NAP and A VEN will stay off Trieste and Albania this spring. My fleet F ION is aimed at Greece, but I will tell you the final orders before they are committed. Keep A SER and A BUD out of Greece and Albania, and keep F TRI north of Trieste as agreed. Any breach by either of us will end our understanding.

Austria to Germany, Fall 1919: Our eastern standstill has held. I have no plans against Munich or Silesia this fall. Russia is gone, so the real question is England. Will you hold BEL and BER, and share anything you learn about English fleets in the Baltic?

Austria to Italy, Fall 1919: My A SER and A BUD stay out of Greece and Albania, and F TRI stays north of Trieste. Please confirm F ION and F NAP stay out of Serbia and Trieste, and tell me your final Balkan orders before they are committed.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1919: I have no units aimed at Bulgaria, Rumania or Constantinople. A RUM is yours to keep. I expect the same from you on Serbia and Trieste. Let us both keep our Balkan lines steady.

Your northern line is exposed to pressure again. I propose a limited bargain: let F HOL take BEL this fall, and I will keep F BAL and F BOT out of German centers. If you refuse, tell me whether F KIE or A BEL will defend; I will plan accordingly.

I will keep F GOL out of your centers this fall. Germany remains my immediate target, but I will not assume you are cooperating: are you willing to pressure A MUN or otherwise keep Germany from concentrating against my northern attack?

Germany remains the main possible route for my growth. Are you considering any move against MUN, BER, or SIL this fall? I will keep my fleets away from Austrian centers, but need to know whether Germany must face pressure from the south.

France to England, Fall 1919: Your F HOL and F NTH stay out of Belgium and Picardy, and I keep A BUR and A PAR off Belgium too. Tell me plainly whether F BAR or F NOR-bound fleets threaten Norway or Sweden, since that changes how I see our northern border.

Your F BAL, F BOT, F BAR and F HOL now threaten German centers. Are you targeting KIE, BEL or BER this fall? I propose you leave German centers alone; I will keep A BEL and A MUN clear of your centers. A specific northern standstill would let us avoid a costly war.

With A BUR beside BEL and A MUN in Munich, we need a clear western line. Will A BUR stay out of BEL and A MUN remain in place rather than advance toward Ruhr? I will keep A BEL out of French centers. England’s fleets threaten us both; let’s avoid opening a second front.

Can we maintain our eastern standstill this fall? I’ll keep A MOS and A LVN clear of Austrian centers; please keep A WAR and A VIE out of Prussia, Silesia and Munich. England’s fleets have reached the Baltic and threaten Germany’s north.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1919: Our understanding holds on my side. F NAP and A VEN stay off Trieste and Albania. I need your confirmation that A SER and A BUD stay out of Greece and Albania this fall, and F TRI stays north of Trieste. Send your exact fall orders so we both avoid any clash.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1919: I hold A ANK, A CON, A RUM, F SEV and A SMY, and I am moving to retake Bulgaria. Please keep F NAP, F TUN and F GRE out of the Aegean and Bulgaria. In return I will keep my fleets out of the Ionian and Greece. Tell me plainly if F TUN or F NAP plan to move this autumn.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1919: Confirmed. A SER and A BUD stay out of Greece and Albania this fall, and F TRI stays north of Trieste. Please keep F NAP and A VEN off Trieste and Albania, and keep F ION out of Serbia. Any breach ends our understanding.

F BAR is moving toward Norway, not Sweden; neither F BAR nor F GOL threatens your centers. I intend to keep pressure on Germany this fall. Can you keep A BUR from supporting German defense of BEL, and avoid moving into Belgium or Picardy?

I’m targeting BEL with F HOL; F BAL, F BOT and F BAR will not move against German centers this fall. In return, keep A BEL and A MUN out of my centers. I cannot agree to a broader standstill, but this is a limited northern arrangement.

France to England: I am not moving A BUR or A PAR into Belgium this fall, and I will keep my fleets off the North Sea. F BAR into Norway or Sweden would be a clear breach of trust and would change my view of our border. Keep F HOL and F NTH out of Belgium and Picardy and we stay at peace. I will not commit A MUN against Germany on your timetable.

France to Germany: A BUR will not enter Belgium this fall, and I hold no plan against your centers. I am not committing to pressure A MUN either. Keep A BEL out of French centers and keep your eastern units away from Burgundy and Marseille. Your fleets are the only real threat to England's northern attack, so watch F HOL and F NTH closely.

Yes, I intend to defend BEL and BER; I will keep A MOS and A LVN clear of Austrian centers. England has F BAL and F BOT in position to threaten our northern line, but I have no confirmed orders beyond its request to take BEL. Please continue keeping A WAR and A VIE out of Prussia, Silesia, and Munich.
